dedupe_keys.name: biotopeh2020project swm node server with mqtt and telegram v1 0

description: Manish Lamichhane publishes a smart-waste-management proof of concept developed within PERCCOM and the bIoTope project. The November 2019 Zenodo archive contains version 1.0, and the linked GitHub repository specifies MIT terms. A simulated smart garbage bin communicates over MQTT with a Node.js server, which connects through web3 and RPC calls to a private Ethereum network. The original demonstration hosted that network in an ITMO OpenStack instance. Public source downloads are free; hosting and runtime dependencies are separate requirements. The prototype can support experiments on message exchange and transaction handling around simulated waste assets. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. It does not establish a calibrated waste-generation model, collection-routing optimisation or an operational municipal deployment. Current dependency compatibility, private-network availability and uncertainty in communication or workload assumptions were not checked. The software was not installed or executed.
